in_hebrew.name: עמרכי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עמרכי - name originating from Igbo language, meaning 'God is faithful' or 'God is the only true God', reflecting Christian values of faithfulness and devotion to a higher power, appearing in Christian communities in Nigeria, and symbolizing trust in God's providence.

in_greek.name: Αμαράχι
in_greek.long_meaning: Αμαράχι - name of Igbo origin, translating to 'God is faithful' or 'God is the only true God', reflecting Christian principles of loyalty and dependence on a higher power, adopted in Christian communities in Nigeria, signifying trust in God's care and provision.
